links.outcome: Demographic skew and stereotyping in AI-generated cancer patient images
links.effect: Images depicted cancer patients as White (83.2%) and middle-aged or older (87.5%). Breast cancer patients were often shown as healthy and happy, and lung cancer patients as ill and hopeless. DALL-E showed more racial diversity than Stable Diffusion.
links.quote: Analysis revealed that AI tools commonly depicted cancer patients as White (83.2%) and middle-aged or older (87.5%).

screen.reason: Content analysis evaluating demographic and stereotypical biases in cancer patient images generated by text-to-image AI tools (DALL-E and Stable Diffusion) for health communication.
